0.original: Tesleen is eager to set off.

25.original: Defeat any coyotes that threaten Tesleen.

27.original: Scout the area ahead and slay any other coyotes.

48.original: Take care with your desert crossing and good fortune with meeting your friend! I'll be around when you're ready to head back to the Exarch.

49.original: Alisaie has been desperate to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, so let's get you to her sooner rather than later!

50.original: The Inn isn't too hard to find, really─you can actually see the top of the rock spires from here.

51.original: We just need to swing around the ridge, then head south. Come on, I'll get my supplies together and meet you outside!

52.original: All set? Oh, I should probably mention the wildlife...

53.original: While most of them will leave you be if you keep your distance, the local coyotes have learned to prey on folk heading home from the markets.

54.original: I can usually swing a sword well enough to fend them off, but I may have loaded myself down with too many bargains today...

55.original: Do you think you can handle any beasts that try to make a meal of us?

56.original: I thought you might. Alisaie was always saying how much y─ Um, I mean, let's get going, shall we?

58.original: Sorry, there wasn't much time to shout a warning. Were you bitten? Those things can be nasty.

59.original: And yet hardly a match for you, it seems! I'd always thought Alisaie was strong, but in her mind, she was never...hmmm. Now it makes sense.

60.original: Ahem, well we should push on! It might be best if you scout ahead and clear out any coyotes that have our scent.

61.original: I'll wait here so you can fight without any distractions!

62.original: It might save time if you could head down past the ridge and clear out any coyotes lurking nearby.

63.original: Oh, thank goodness you're back. I could hear the howling and snarling from here... Frightful creatures.

64.original: Let's hope the rest have seen your handiwork, and know to avoid us now. I need to get these supplies back to the Inn!

65.original: This is it! Thanks to you, I didn't have to drop my shopping even once! Come to think of it, I'm glad I didn't make the trip alone...

66.original: It seems <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> ended up escorting <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>! I'll have to repay the favor somehow, but first, let's head inside, shall we?

67.original: Welcome to the Inn at Journey's Head. You might be our first visitor from the Crystarium since Alisaie arrived.

68.original: It's not much, but it's home for the afflicted and a handful of carers.

71.original: This illness isn't contagious, is it?

72.original: I have some skill with healing...

74.original: Contagious...? Well, no, not as far as we know.

75.original: I'm not sure you can help in this case, but...that's good to know.

76.original: I don't think I've met anyone besides Alisaie who was so unfamiliar with our situation here. Most folk have grown up knowing someone who knew someone...

77.original: Hm. I might leave out something obvious, so it may be best to have Alisaie give you the full explanation.
